description: Dated adoption series: share of sites whose robots.txt takes a stance on AI agents, by Common Crawl epoch, single vantage. Called with no arguments it returns the trend and the caveats, not the whole table. Pass `epoch` for one point, `series: true` for all of them, or `withheld: true` for the undersampled epochs that are kept out of the series. Caveats are always included — read them before quoting a number.

epoch.description: A Common Crawl epoch id, e.g. CC-MAIN-2026-39.

series.description: Return every epoch in the series.

withheld.description: Return the epochs withheld for n < min_n.

name: adoption_curve
